question_vi: Git rebase vs merge khác nhau? Khi nào dùng gì?
question_en: How are git rebase and merge different? When should you use each?
answer_vi: Merge: tạo merge commit, giữ history đầy đủ, safe cho shared branches. Rebase: rewrite history thành linear, clean hơn, KHÔNG dùng cho shared branches. Best practice: rebase feature branch lên develop trước khi merge (hoặc squash merge). `git rebase -i` để clean commits.
answer_en: Merge: creates a merge commit, preserves full history, safe for shared branches. Rebase: rewrites history to be linear and cleaner — NEVER use on shared branches. Best practice: rebase your feature branch onto develop before merging (or use squash merge). `git rebase -i` for cleaning up commits interactively.
